tool_input.command: ls -la; cat auth.curlrc | sed 's/\(token\|Bearer\)[^"]*/\1 ***/I'; curl -sK auth.curlrc "https://api.github.com/repos/JogoShugh/heart-github-test/issues?labels=mess-A-gen-prompt-2&state=open" | jq '[.[]|{number,title,pr:(.pull_request!=null)}]'
for n in 2007 2006 2004 2003; do curl -sK auth.curlrc https://api.github.com/repos/JogoShugh/heart-github-test/pulls/$n | jq -c '{number,state,draft,mergeable,base:.base.ref,sha:.head.sha}'; done
chmod +x merge-bumps.sh && bash -n merge-bumps.sh && echo ok

I wrote `merge-bumps.sh` in this folder. It takes `owner repo label` and uses only curl and jq. It applies the same rules in the same order and prints one line per PR. It reads the token from `auth.curlrc` in the current directory, or from the path in `AUTH_CURLRC` if you set it.
